answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock blocks fake identities. Each new agent locks a 50-coin deposit that unlocks only after its behavior fingerprint holds for 20 epochs, with each vertex tied to one fingerprint. To forge 100 identities, an attacker must run 100 histories for 20 epochs and lock 5000 coins, while an honest agent pays one deposit and earns undiluted rewards once unlocked. Copied patterns drain through karst and freeze the escrow.
